scripts.speaker: Parmy Gianino
scripts.text:
Welcome to the
Alchemist Unio--
I-Impossible! How c-can
something like this happen?

scripts.speaker: Parmy Gianino
scripts.text:
Welcome, {0}.
The Alchemist Union
is busy today, like always.

scripts.speaker: Parmy Gianino
scripts.text:
Welcome to the
Alchemist Union.
We are recruiting
talented people
with novel ideas.

scripts.speaker: Parmy Gianino
scripts.text:
Welcome to the
Alchemist Union.
How may I help you?

scripts.speaker: Parmy Gianino
scripts.text:
Well now~!
You've brought an
Old Magic Book and
a Hammer of Blacksmith.
We'll put these items
to good use.

scripts.speaker: Parmy Gianino
scripts.text:
Seems like
you're all ready.
The Union will put
these items to good use.

scripts.speaker: Parmy Gianino
scripts.text:
Aren't you ready?
Like I said before,
you must bring
^551A8B{0}^000000.

scripts.speaker: Parmy Gianino
scripts.text:
Go and talk to
Mr. Raspuchin.
He's involved in the
Alchemist selection process, whatever that might mean.

scripts.speaker: Parmy Gianino
scripts.text:
Ah, I'm sorry, but
I'm busy right now~

scripts.speaker: Parmy Gianino
scripts.text:
Wait, wait...
I'm sorry. I was confused,
that's all. You look just like
someone I used to know. 
Still, I get this weird
feeling about you...

scripts.speaker: Parmy Gianino
scripts.text:
Everyone is busy with their
own research, but recently, some headway has been made in the field of biotechnology.

scripts.speaker: Parmy Gianino
scripts.text: Everyone is hoping that the biotechnological studies will yield positive results. Speaking of which, I wonder how the Alchemists working on artificial life are doing...

scripts.speaker: Parmy Gianino
scripts.text: If you're interested in working with chemistry, visit us later when you become more knowledgable.

scripts.speaker: Parmy Gianino
scripts.text:
Just one thing:
You've got to have
knowledge of items
as a Merchant first.

scripts.speaker: Parmy Gianino
scripts.text: If you know any exceptional Merchants, by all means, please refer them to us. Those types of people tend to have a talent for Alchemy and experimentation~
I would like to learn about Alchemists.
I want to become an Alchemist.
Nothing.

scripts.speaker: Parmy Gianino
scripts.text: Alchemists study and create new substances and items out of existing materials. Our knowledge allows us to change the properties of chemicals at the atomic level.

scripts.speaker: Parmy Gianino
scripts.text:
Most people think our final goal
is to create gold, but that's not the entire truth. We also want to create things like medicines
and new materials.

scripts.speaker: Parmy Gianino
scripts.text:
A few of us research the
creation of life, although many of us consider that god's territory. That field is so complex, most of us deal with slightly less complicated projects anyway.

scripts.speaker: Parmy Gianino
scripts.text: If you are interested in becoming an Alchemist, I recommend that you first get a lot of experience as a Merchant. Being a Merchant is a great opportunity to learn about materials as you deal with them.

scripts.speaker: Parmy Gianino
scripts.text:
Whether or not you try to become
an Alchemist is your decision. The road to becoming an Alchemist is very challenging, and you'll need to focus on experimentation and research, instead of commerce.

scripts.speaker: Parmy Gianino
scripts.text:
Is that so?
Nice to meet you.
My name is Parmy Gianino
of the Alchemist Union.

scripts.speaker: Parmy Gianino
scripts.text:
If you join our Union and
complete the training, you
will be officially recognized
as an Alchemist and be able
to contribute to our research.

scripts.speaker: Parmy Gianino
scripts.text:
But we don't accept everyone.
You must have a lot of tenacity
and sincere devotion in exploring
the various fields of science.

scripts.speaker: Parmy Gianino
scripts.text:
There are a couple
of requirements to join
the Alchemist Union, but
we'll discuss that
after you apply.

scripts.speaker: Parmy Gianino
scripts.text:
Well then, would
you like to apply
for registration?
I would like to apply.
I'll do it later.

scripts.speaker: Parmy Gianino
scripts.text:
Hmmm...
Just a moment.
I'm sorry to say that
you're not experienced
enough as a Merchant to
join us right now.

scripts.speaker: Parmy Gianino
scripts.text:
You must be at least
^551A8BJob Level 40^000000 to become
an Alchemist. Come back
later when you meet the
Job Level requirement, okay?

scripts.speaker: Parmy Gianino
scripts.text: Alright, your application has been accepted. Now, you must pay the 50,000 Zeny application fee and bring some items before you can begin your formal training.

scripts.speaker: Parmy Gianino
scripts.text:
But if you bring an ^551A8BOld Magic Book^000000 and ^551A8BHammer of Blacksmith^000000,
we will accept that as a substitute for the item requirement.

scripts.speaker: Parmy Gianino
scripts.text:
Now...
Please sign
the application.

scripts.speaker: Parmy Gianino
scripts.text:
Good, good. Now, if you have
the Zeny for your application fee ready, I will tell you which items you will need to bring. Now, pay attention.

scripts.speaker: Parmy Gianino
scripts.text:
Uh oh. You don't
seem to have enough Zeny.
Come back to me when you have 50,000 Zeny, otherwise we can't process your application.

scripts.speaker: Parmy Gianino
Parmy Gianino
scripts.text:
Let's see.
{0}
needs to bring...
^551A8B7 Berserk Potions^000000.

scripts.speaker: Parmy Gianino
scripts.text:
Let's see.
{0}
needs to bring...
^551A8B100 Mini Furnaces^000000.

scripts.speaker: Parmy Gianino
scripts.text:
Let's see.
{0}
needs to bring...
^551A8B7,500 Fire Arrows^000000.

scripts.speaker: Parmy Gianino
scripts.text:
Once you've gathered
those items, come back
to me and your training
as an Alchemist will begin.
See you soon~

scripts.speaker: Parmy Gianino
scripts.text:
Talented Merchants
are always welcome here.
Please come back soon.

scripts.speaker: Parmy Gianino
scripts.text:
Umm...
Please let me know
if you need anything.

scripts.speaker: Parmy Gianino
scripts.text:
Okay, now you need to learn
the basics to being an Alchemist and learn the procedures for mixing chemicals and medicines.

scripts.speaker: Parmy Gianino
scripts.text: But before all of that, you need to speak to Raspuchin. I'm not really sure what you'll be talking about with him...

scripts.speaker: Parmy Gianino
scripts.text: It shouldn't be anything extraordinary, but you're still required to speak to Raspuchin, since apparently he's a part of the Alchemist selection process.

scripts.speaker: Parmy Gianino
scripts.text:
Okay, now you need to learn
the basics to being an Alchemist and learn the procedures for mixing chemicals and medicines.

scripts.speaker: Parmy Gianino
scripts.text: But before all of that, you need to speak to Raspuchin. I'm not really sure what you'll be talking about with him...

scripts.speaker: Parmy Gianino
scripts.text: It shouldn't be anything extraordinary, but you're still required to speak to Raspuchin, since apparently he's a part of the Alchemist selection process.

scripts.speaker: Parmy Gianino
scripts.text:
Come back when you
have prepared the
required items.

scripts.speaker: Parmy Gianino
scripts.text:
Hopefully, it
won't be too much of
a problem. I guess he'll just interview you, and ask you
some simple questions.

scripts.speaker: Parmy Gianino
scripts.text:
Why don't you ask
someone else if you're
not sure who to visit
next? Good luck~

scripts.speaker: Raspuchin Gregory
scripts.text:
Heeheehee
keheheh~!
Eh? What do you want?!

scripts.speaker: Raspuchin Gregory
scripts.text:
Heeheehee
keheheh~!
How cute, you've come
all this way just to play...

scripts.speaker: Raspuchin Gregory
scripts.text:
What is it?!
You're curious as
to what I'm doing?

scripts.speaker: Raspuchin Gregory
scripts.text:
Heeheehee
keheheh~!
What do you
want, kid?

scripts.speaker: Raspuchin Gregory
scripts.text:
What...?!
You want to take
the test again?!
I thought I told
you to leave!

scripts.speaker: Raspuchin Gregory
scripts.text:
What are you doing?
Go and find Darwin now.

scripts.speaker: Raspuchin Gregory
scripts.text:
Keheheheheheheheh~
Don't think this is the end of it!

scripts.speaker: Raspuchin Gregory
scripts.text: You're not here to steal my experimental results or plagiarize my work, are you? How dare you consider intellectual theft!

scripts.speaker: Raspuchin Gregory
scripts.text:
You're not, are you?
Well, as a colleague,
let me just warn you
that such tricks aren't
tolerated here in the
Alchemist Union!

scripts.speaker: Raspuchin Gregory
scripts.text:
I'll let you
go this time...
But next time, don't
expect to leave so easily...

scripts.speaker: Raspuchin Gregory
scripts.text:
Heehee
keheheh~!
Why, I'm busy
researching,
of course!

scripts.speaker: Raspuchin Gregory
scripts.text:
Once this
potion is complete...
You can use it to take
over an entire nation!

scripts.speaker: Raspuchin Gregory
scripts.text:
Hee hee hee!
Something this
dangerous has to
be kept a secret!
Understand?

scripts.speaker: Raspuchin Gregory
scripts.text: A Merchant should go and set up shop and vend items. Why are you wandering in a place like this?

scripts.speaker: Raspuchin Gregory
scripts.text:
Heheheh~!
Go vend somwhere else!
And leave me to my
dark enterprise!

scripts.speaker: Raspuchin Gregory
scripts.text:
What...?
Learn Alchemy?!
Don't even speak
such nonsense!

scripts.speaker: Raspuchin Gregory
scripts.text: Even if you tried studying for a thousand years, maybe even more, it'd be useless to you! Forget about it and just worry about your store!

scripts.speaker: Raspuchin Gregory
scripts.text:
What...?
Join the Union!?
I don't like it...
I just don't...!

scripts.speaker: Raspuchin Gregory
scripts.text:
Nowadays, anyone thinks they can
be Alchemists just by knowing how to mix a few herbs. That's why my interview is necessary.

scripts.speaker: Raspuchin Gregory
scripts.text:
Heeheehee
keheheh~!
I plan on weeding out all the dumb and incompetent, and chase them
all away! We don't need morons!

scripts.speaker: Raspuchin Gregory
scripts.text:
Wait...
Maybe I've
misjudged you.
You might be a pretty boy,
but I can tell you're smart
from your eyes.

scripts.speaker: Raspuchin Gregory
scripts.text:
Wait...
Maybe I've
misjudged you.
Huh. You're a cutie alright,
but I can tell you've got brains.

scripts.speaker: Raspuchin Gregory
scripts.text:
You're not just some stupid kid.
I can tell youve gone through some rough times as a Merchant. Excellent. Keh heh heh~

scripts.speaker: Raspuchin Gregory
scripts.text: Fine, just so we don't insult each other's intelligence, I'll just let you pass the interview.

scripts.speaker: Raspuchin Gregory
scripts.text: So hurry up, become an Alchemist, do some good research, and you might turn out to be of some help to me. Hahahahahaha~!

scripts.speaker: Raspuchin Gregory
scripts.text:
Now go to Darwin!
He'll teach you how to do the experiments. Just tell him that
I sent you.

scripts.speaker: Raspuchin Gregory
scripts.text:
Surprised, are you?
Keheheh~ If you thought
becoming an Alchemist was
just a matter of changing
your clothes, then you're
sadly mistaken.

scripts.speaker: Raspuchin Gregory
scripts.text:
Now, try solving
all these problems.
Let's see how smart
really are.

scripts.speaker: Raspuchin Gregory
scripts.text:
I don't like it...
I don't like this!

scripts.speaker: Raspuchin Gregory
scripts.text:
Fine...
I'll try to overlook your pitiful performance last time and give
you another chance. Don't screw
up again, got it?

scripts.speaker: Raspuchin Gregory
scripts.text:
Now then,
give me all the
^551A8Bright^000000 answers
this time.

scripts.speaker: Raspuchin Gregory
scripts.text:
How much do
12 Red Potions,
1 Butterfly Wing
and 5 Fly Wings cost
after a 24 % discount?

scripts.speaker: Raspuchin Gregory
scripts.text:
What is the
total weight of
3 Scimiters, 2 Helms
and 1 Long Coat?

scripts.speaker: Raspuchin Gregory
scripts.text:
What is the
total defense of
a Biretta, Mantle,
Opera Mask, Ribbon,
Muffler, Boots, and
Ear Muffs?

scripts.speaker: Raspuchin Gregory
scripts.text:
If you buy 5 Helms
with a 24 % discount
and sell it at 20
how much profit
do you earn?

scripts.speaker: Raspuchin Gregory
scripts.text:
What is the
total price of
15 Green Potions,
6 Magnifiers and
4 Traps after
a 24 % discount?

scripts.speaker: Raspuchin Gregory
scripts.text:
What is the
total weight of
3 Ring Pommel Sabers,
4 Caps, and 2 Boots?

scripts.speaker: Raspuchin Gregory
scripts.text:
What is the
total defense of
a Buckler, Long Coat,
Gas Mask, Big Ribbon,
Cute Ribbon, Sakkat,
and Glasses?

scripts.speaker: Raspuchin Gregory
scripts.text:
How much profit do you
make if you buy Tights
at a 24 % discount and
sell it at 20 % of
the normal price?

scripts.speaker: Raspuchin Gregory
scripts.text:
What is the
total cost of
6 Red Potions,
7 Green Potions,
and 8 Fly Wings
after a 24 % discount?

scripts.speaker: Raspuchin Gregory
scripts.text:
What is the
total weight of
2 Ring Pommel Sabers,
3 Caps, and 3 boots?

scripts.speaker: Raspuchin Gregory
scripts.text:
What is the
total defense of
a Mirror Shield, Mr. Smile, Leather Jacket, Silk Robe, Wedding Veil, Muffler, and Eye Patch?

scripts.speaker: Raspuchin Gregory
scripts.text:
If you buy 4 Padded Armors
at a 24% discount and sell
them at 20% of the original
price, how much profit would
you make from this sale?

scripts.speaker: Raspuchin Gregory
scripts.text:
Ooh...
Excellent! Great!
You got them all correct!?
Keheheh, I have no choice but to acknowledge you...

scripts.speaker: Raspuchin Gregory
scripts.text:
You got one wrong!
But I'll let it slide.
You pass the interview!

scripts.speaker: Raspuchin Gregory
scripts.text:
You've got serious
weaknesses in math,
but I'll let you go this time...

scripts.speaker: Raspuchin Gregory
scripts.text:
Keheheh! Idiot!
Just listening to your
answers is making me feel
stupider! You might as well
have got them all wrong!

scripts.speaker: Raspuchin Gregory
scripts.text:
How can a person that
can't even answer all of
these simple questions think
of becoming an Alchemist?!

scripts.speaker: Raspuchin Gregory
scripts.text:
Hm...?
Did you get
any right?

scripts.speaker: Raspuchin Gregory
scripts.text:
Fool! Even if you make one little mistake, everything goes wrong
in Alchemy! Now get out of here!
You make me sick!

scripts.speaker: Raspuchin Gregory
scripts.text: So hurry up, become an Alchemist, do some good research, and you might turn out to be of some help to me. Hahahahahaha~!

scripts.speaker: Raspuchin Gregory
scripts.text:
Now go to Darwin!
He'll teach you how to do the experiments. Just tell him that
I sent you.

scripts.speaker: Raspuchin Gregory
scripts.text:
Keheheheheheheheh~
Don't think this is the end of it!

- Wait a minute! -
- Currently you are carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please come back again -
- after you store some items into kafra storage. -

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text:
Ah...
You...
You've become
an Alchemist.

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text:
When you have
your dreams, you
have everything.
Without them, you have
nothing more to lose.

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text:
I said to go
to Van Helmont.
I'd like to teach you
more, but I can't.

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text:
I have already given you all of my knowledge and have nothing more
to teach you.

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text:
Remember...
In your quest
to make your
dreams come true,
do not lose what
you cherish.

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text:
Ah...
Harmona...
My love...

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text:
These cursed eyes...
They've lost sight of
my dreams a long time ago.
Ha ha ha ha...

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text:
Does paradise
really exist...?
Not without my love...
Not without Harmona...

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text:
A wolf?
Or a human?
You must be seeking
something, are you not?

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text:
After all...
Everyone has desires
to fulfill. Be be careful.
Do not be like the wild
wolf drawn to the flowers.

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text: In your efforts to gain something else, you may end up sacrificing something precious to you.

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text:
Cultivating joy and happiness
is much like cultivating flowers.
If something is missing, the
flower will wilt away...

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text:
What brings you
to this kind of place?
I want to learn how to experiment.
Tell me more about flowers.
Nothing.

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text:
You wish to
learn Alchemy?
Everything I know,
I've learned for the
sake of making my
dream come true...

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text:
I'll teach
you the basics...
But everything you
learn afterwards must
be directed through
your own motivations.

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text:
I will teach you
how to make simple
medicine. So please
bring the following
materials right away.

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text:
^551A8B3 Medicine Bowls^000000,
^551A8B3 Empty Bottles^000000,
^551A8B1 Red Herb^000000,
^551A8B1 Yellow Herb^000000 and
^551A8B1 White Herb^000000.

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text:
Once you have
prepared everything,
return to me.

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text:
Flowers...?
In the darkest
recesses of my mind,
there is a blossum
that I faintly remember...

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text:
For the one that
I love, I put all
of my efforts into
researching that one thing.

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text:
I won't tell you the details,
but I was basically researching
the relationship between
wolves and flowers.

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text:
But yes...
It was a flower.
With its shine, it was said
to let you see paradise.
The ^551A8BIllusion Flower^000000...

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text:
I even made
a Homunculus,
but no one believed that I could create new life from a flower...

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text:
Then...
Well, some other things happened, and now I have nothing left. Time no longer has any meaning for me.

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text:
Ahh...
Harmona...
Where have you gone?
I hope you're in a field
of beautiful flowers...

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text:
Consider what
is most precious
to you. It cannot
be protected if you
do not recognize it.

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text:
Ah...
You are the one who
wishes to learn Alchemy.
Have you prepared everything?

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text:
Wait.
That Illusion Flower.
How did you get that?

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text:
Where did you find it?!
The flower that slowly
blooms under the
moonlight?
It's beautiful...!

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text:
Th-That flower...
Please let me see it.
The Illusion Flower!
Uwaaaaaaah!!

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text:
Would you be so kind
as to let me have this flower?
I'm sure that this is the Moonlight Flower that I've been seeking!
Sorry, I can't give it to you.
I brought it to give to you.

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text:
I understand.
You can't give
such a precious
flower to just anyone.
Well... It's okay.

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text: It just brought back old memories. I shouldn't have asked in the first place. In any case, please bring what is needed for the experiment.

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text:
Please leave that flower
somewhere else. It brings
back too many memories...

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text:
Are you
serious?!
Thank you!
Such a precious flower.
Ah, Harmona, my love...

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text:
Yes...
I shall repay you for this.
I shall plant all of my knowledge of Alchemy directly into your mind...

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text:
Open your eyes wide,
and look into my eyes!!
Don't stop until the end!!

^666666*Gasp...*^000000
You are now
an Alchemist!!
Go to the Union
and cast away the last
vestiges of Merchant life!!

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text: Seems like you have everything ready. As promised, I will teach you how to make simple medicine.

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text: First, prepare the Medicine Bowl. Then, you put the Herbs inside, like this, and slowly crush them.

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text:
Pour small amounts
of clean water and stir
the mixture until it thickens.
Afterwards, add some more Herbs.

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text: That's how you make it. If you think you have enough, gently pour the mixture into an empty bottle.

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text:
There you go,
it's complete.
Now, make some medicine
using the simple procedure
I just explained to you.
Prepare the Medicine Bowl.
Put the Medicine Bowl on your head.
Kick the Medicine Bowl.

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text: What...?

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text: No!
Put some dirt in the Medicine Bowl.
Put some Herbs in the Medicine Bowl.
Put a Harp in the Medicine Bowl.

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text:
...Eh!?
That's not
medicine!

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text:
A Harp?
And how would
you do that?
Crush the Herbs.
Crush the Medicine Bowl.
Crush Darwin's foot.

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text:
Wh-What are
you doing!?

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text:
Agh...!
What do you
think you're
doing?!
Spray clean water.
Drink clean water.
Pour clean water.

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text:
Huh?
What are you doing?

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text:
W-wait...
Are you
taking a break?
Continue crushing the Herbs.
Continue eating the Herbs.
Continue dancing and singing.

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text:
Eat the Herbs?
I think you need
to focus on the
task at hand...

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text:
Singing and
dancing? Alchemists
don't do that, have
you gone crazy?
Put noodles in and fry it.
Pour it in an empty bottle.
Hold the Medicine Bowl and drink it.

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text:
We're Alchemists,
not restaurant chefs.

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text:
Huh...
Pretty sloppy...

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text:
You messed up the mixture
since you didn't follow the procedure! Get some more ingredients so you can try it
again until you get it right.

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text:
Good job.
It came out pretty well considering it's your first time. Go ahead and keep the medicines that you've just made.

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text:
Now, go into the next room
and speak to Van Helmont to
continue your training.

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text:
Never forget...
You must always protect
what is most precious to you.

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text:
Have you forgotten
what you need to bring?
Let me remind you once
again. You must come
back with...

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text:
^551A8B3 Medicine Bowls^000000,
^551A8B3 Empty Bottle^000000,
^551A8B1 Red Herb^000000,
^551A8B1 Yellow Herb^000000 and
^551A8B1 White Herb^000000.

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text:
Come back
when you are
ready...

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text:
Aah...
Harmona, my love.
I can't even see the flower anymore. My soul quietly
withers as well..

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text:
Go to the second floor and talk to speak to our Union Leader. Once
you do that, your life as an Alchemist will begin.

scripts.speaker: Darwin
scripts.text:
These cursed eyes...
They've lost sight of
